cua_lite_contamination.action: Mark CUA-Lite/ScaleCUA-derived donors as contamination-unknown for the virgin holdout; require task-ID and source-manifest audit before using behavioral results.
cua_lite_contamination.risk_assessment: Donor models trained on ScaleCUA or CUA-Lite ScaleCUA rollouts may have direct or near-direct OSWorld task, setup, judge, or trajectory overlap. This is a provenance risk only; public metadata does not prove overlap with the reserved local holdout IDs.
verified_claims: CUA-Lite Lite.ScaleCUA exposes a train split (20,289 rows) and an rl split (2,049 rows) sourced from extreme1228/ScaleCUA/osworld/generated_tasks and extreme1228/ScaleCUA/osworld/rl_tasks.
The adapter states that these are OSWorld-shaped tasks and recommends canonical lite.osworld eval for evaluation.
ScaleCUA publicly releases OSWorld RL tasks and OSWorld judge functions; its paper reports OSWorld evaluation.

sanitization.donor_metadata_json_email_scan: passed; no email-like strings found in /tmp/astra-merge-fara-tmax.json

Fara_vs_Qwen.meaning: Fara repeats the value already present in rope_parameters.partial_rotary_factor; semantically equivalent.
Qwen Transformers explicitly normalizes qwen3_5 to qwen3_5_vision in __post_init__; equivalent under official loader, but raw strings are not identical.

Holo_vs_Fara.meaning: Fara advertises one MTP layer; Holo does not.
Fara explicitly disables dedicated MTP embeddings; Holo omits the field.
Holo retains a router auxiliary-loss field, although both are dense Qwen3.5 configs and no router tensors were observed.

semantic_config_differences.strict_gate_recommendation: Treat vision configs as semantically equivalent only after applying the official loader normalization; retain a raw-config warning. Holo/Fara still differ in MTP/router metadata, but their 723 common tensor keys have exact shapes and dtypes.

sources.caveat: Do not transfer ARM numerical results to this merge: architecture, expert pool, calibration data, and benchmarks differ.
sources.title: ARM: Role-Conditioned Neuron Transplantation for Training-Free Generalist LLM Agent Merging
verified_claims: Training-free three-stage pipeline: candidate backbone construction, role-conditioned activation selection, conflict-aware neuron transplantation.
Uses role-conditioned MLP activation tracing on calibration trajectories; reports four in-domain suites and two out-of-domain benchmarks.
The paper explicitly includes OS and WebShop in case studies, but find/search of the official HTML found no OSWorld occurrence.

sources.caveat: These are UI-Venus results and include OSWorld-G variants; they do not establish that the local virgin holdout is uncontaminated.
sources.title: UI-Venus-1.5 Technical Report
verified_claims: Mid-training uses 10 billion tokens across 30+ datasets.
Pipeline is mid-training, task-specific offline RL, online RL, then model merge.
Model merge combines grounding, web, and mobile specialists using linear merge or TIES-Merge.
Reports ScreenSpot-Pro 69.6%, VenusBench-GD 75.0%, AndroidWorld 77.6%; OSWorld-G and OSWorld-G-R are evaluated, with 70.6% and 76.4% for the 30B-A3B model.
